POCKET SD CARD MANAGER / DESKTOP PREVIEW

Choose cores.
Review files.
Then apply.

Manage your Analogue Pocket SD card.

ez-pocket reads the card and lists your cores. Choose what to keep. Check the files it will add, replace, or remove. The app writes only after you approve. It also has separate tools for firmware, saves, and images.

GET THE DESKTOP PREVIEW ↓SEE HOW IT WORKS ↘

Open source. No account needed.

BEFORE A WRITE

A scan does not change your card. Review the files before you write.

THE WORKFLOW

Choose cores.
Check the files.

The app finds the cores on your card and checks what is available. You decide what to install, update, or remove.

01

Choose your cores.

Search by system name. Compare the version on your card with the available version. Pick cores one by one, or start with a set.

System names come first.
Core IDs are there when you need them.

02

Check the files.

See each file the app will add, replace, or remove. The review also shows conflicts and anything that would block the sync.

The app backs up core files it replaces or removes.
If a sync fails, it tries to restore changed files.

WATCH THE 30-SECOND DEMO +

MORE TOOLS

Firmware, saves,
and other files.

These tools are separate from core sync. When a tool writes to the card, you review its changes first.

01 / CORESCore inventory
Search for cores, compare versions, and choose what to keep. Check the file list before you sync.
02 / SAVE VAULTSave backups
Back up saves and Memories to your computer. Choose a snapshot and review the files before a restore.
03 / FIRMWAREFirmware updates
Check Analogue's PocketOS download. The app checks its published checksum before it stages the file.
04 / HEALTHCard checks
Check for missing folders, core metadata the app cannot read, and low free space. This check does not write to the card.
05 / ASSETSPalettes and images
Add optional palettes and supported images. Review the files before you write.
06 / DIAGNOSTICSDiagnostics
Export a report when you need help. It leaves out target paths and error messages. You choose whether to share it.

Unsigned previews. No separate .NET runtime needed. RELEASE NOTES & MAC CHECKSUM ↗

BEFORE YOU START

These are early test builds. Back up your SD card before trying them, and keep the card connected while changes are being applied.

WINDOWS
Windows 10 1809 or later · x64. Extract the ZIP and run EzPocket.exe. Keep all files together. SmartScreen or organization policy may warn or block it.
MACOS
Experimental · Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Extract the ZIP and move EzPocket.app to Applications. Unsigned and not notarized: attempt to open it once, then use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway and confirm Open. Intel Macs are not supported.
LINUX
Experimental · x64 · GTK 4.12+ and its introspection typelib. Extract the archive and run ./EzPocket.Linux.
